results.description: The search parameter reflects input without encoding, allowing script execution in a victim browser.
results.impact: An attacker could execute script in a victim's browser session.
results.remediation: Encode all reflected output and apply context-appropriate output encoding.
results.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the lab search page.
2. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in the search box.

3. Observe the script executing.
results.title: Reflected cross-site scripting in search parameter
